title: Identical ordinary halo moments, different prescribed-bar response
finding: The p=8 pair has a positive accumulated-transfer contrast at the reference frequency and passes the selected phase and timestep screens. Density, local mean velocity and every even velocity moment match analytically; higher odd moments differ.
inference: A bounded response of analytic halo populations to specified external fields, not different self-consistent bar evolution.

release.source_scope: Frozen positive populations, unforced algebra challenge, archived inspection sources and compact saved-response operands.
release.reproduction_scope: The portable NumPy/SciPy replay recomputes six contractions, seed-library intervals, reference uncertainty, covariance and selected paired numerical changes from supplied impulses and stored sampling DF values. It does not regenerate the sampled orbits, the velocity-marginal quadrature, live dynamics or a new forcing history.
release.note: Original archived input/evidence hashes remain unchanged. New release metadata identifies the compact analysis bundle; complete trajectory-array evolution is not supplied.

model.system: Collisionless tracer orbits; the halo and bar fields do not react.
model.forcing: The full rotating quadrupole is present at time zero; no growth ramp.
model.source_scope: The total isochrone-plus-quadrupole source is positive; the quadrupole alone is a signed zero-total-mass density. This is an imposed source, not a stellar disc.

population.positivity: Fplus and Fminus are at least F0/2 throughout the bound orbital domain.
population.equilibrium_scope: Stationary and self-consistent in the unsoftened spherical reference only; collective stability and a live disc are untested.
population.physical_weighting: Exact analytic F0 plus/minus alpha deltaF divided by AGAMA sampling DF; common fixed sampling mass retained, no per-population or per-library renormalization
population.importance_formula: m_i(F0 +/- alpha deltaF)/Fq; Fq is the actual AGAMA sampling DF

observable.name: Accumulated bar-mediated angular-momentum transfer
observable.contrast: Total transfer to Fplus minus total transfer to Fminus, through T=300
observable.sign: Positive transfer means Lz supplied by the imposed bar to the tracer population.
observable.units: Reference mass times length squared per time; G=M=1 and b=0.5, no galaxy calibration.
observable.reference: Same prescribed history, velocity-even exact analytic F0 with mass one.
observable.ratio: Ratio of ensemble point means; no qualified ratio interval or factor threshold.

figure.title: Paired accumulated-transfer contrasts
figure.caption: Fplus minus Fminus in the same prescribed rotating field, through T=300. Nominal intervals use eight whole libraries; populations and histories are correlated. Selected numerical screens and sampling intervals are separate assessments.
